items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire tears (pressing a movement-style direction like Left arrow fires, it does not move the character); E places a bomb and decrements the bomb HUD counter; tutorial wall hints list MOVE=WASD, ATTACK=arrows, BOMB=E, ITEM=Space (Space untested).

Item: collected 'TECH X - Laser ring tears' from a red chest. Firing now spawns a stationary red laser ring roughly ~100-150px ahead of the player in the fire direction; the ring lingers and slowly grinds down whatever overlaps it, then fades. Being closer than the spawn offset makes shots miss targets; standing ~110px from a target before firing lands the ring on it. Sustained fire on the same spot was needed to kill a blue fly.

Hazards/objects (observed): own bomb explosions damage the player (lost hearts); bomb blasts destroyed a ring of rocks; a bomb placed against suspicious-looking right-wall crack/stain patterns did nothing (likely decorative). Regular brown poop piles barely take laser damage and effectively resisted destruction; a golden-brown poop vanished on contact and gave a coin. Poop piles regenerate/reappear when re-entering rooms. Some metal/gray chests did not open on mere adjacency (0 keys in HUD); one gray chest opened on direct contact after its room's blue fly was killed, dropping a heart pickup and a bomb-orb pickup (heart restored health; orb gave +1 bomb). A red chest in a treasure room granted an item. Key-shaped sprites seen on floors turned out to be my own laser particles (they moved relative to the player), and the HUD key counter never rose.

Health/HUD (observed): HUD shows hearts, coins, bombs, keys, and a curse-like icon; blue soul heart appeared as extra health; heart pickups raise health. Touching a corner chest in the multi-chest room cost several hearts in one contact (possible mimic/spike chest) - guess, not confirmed.

Doors/transitions (observed): golden trapdoors on the bottom wall descend to the next room only when the player stands fully/centered on them; gold crown/ladder hatches on the top wall warp rooms only when the player is centered and walking upward into them from below (side-edge entry did not trigger). Dark trapezoid doorways at top/bottom centers are ordinary room connections. A dark doorway set into the right wall existed but had to be entered at the correct vertical band (roughly y 310-400 in that room) - pushing right at the wrong height just pressed against the wall.

Navigation learned: tutorial room (wall hints, top/bottom dark doors, right-wall doorway) -> bottom door leads to a rock-ring chest room (chest inside rock ring, locked-looking, gold trapdoor at bottom). Descending led to a red treasure chest room (gave Tech X). Further trapdoor led to a gray-metal-chest room with torches, rocks, poop, blue fly, gold trapdoor. That trapdoor led to a two-poop crawl-like room with gold crown hatch at top and no other exits; its crown hatch connects back up to a torch/rock room (poop, scorch mark, gold trapdoor bottom). That torch room's top dark trapezoid door led back to the tutorial room, forming a loop. The tutorial room's right-wall doorway led to a new dark rock room containing two corner chests (top-left, top-right), a central chest ringed by white spikes flanked by black poop piles, and a red chest inside the spikes.

Failed strategies: walking into locked/metal chests did not open them without the room's conditions being met; firing while adjacent to targets wasted the ring past them; bombing the crawl-room right wall opened nothing; entering crown hatches from the side edge never warped; treating stationary floor key-sprites as pickups failed (they were particles).

Active goals: find health/items (survival was threatened after a damaging chest contact); investigate remaining chests (top-right corner chest, spike-ringed central chest) and determine what the spike-ring chest requires.

Unresolved hypotheses (guesses): whether some chests are mimics/spike chests that damage on touch; whether any chest genuinely needs a key (HUD keys have stayed 0 and key-sprites proved to be particles); whether regular poop piles are destructible at all; whether the cracked/stained wall areas conceal secret rooms (one bomb test negative); whether the central white-spike ring can be safely entered.
